cohort: 1,219 pregnant patients with a singleton gestation and a positive test result for SARS-CoV-2 who delivered at 1 of 33 U.S. hospitals in 14 states from March 1 to July 31, 2020
finding: The study found that pregnant patients with severe-critical COVID-19, but not those with mild-moderate COVID-19, were at increased risk of perinatal complications compared to asymptomatic patients.
mod_finding: Severe-critical COVID-19 was associated with increased risk of cesarean birth.
